# Nell Harcourt & Winifred Tolley

- [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) — Friend of — [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) — friendly tea companions and neighbors · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P78](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0078), [v4 CHAPTER 37 MISS WINIFRED MAKES A STARTLING ANNOUNCEMENT P12](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0012)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh reflect happily on their flawless honeymoon in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Hugh shares his pride in saving a patient's life overnight. Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) arrives to pay a visit while sewing a baby gown, keeping [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and an eavesdropping Hugh entertained with her straightforward and opinionated commentary on neighbors, men, and church denominations.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P1](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P37](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0037)_

> Miss Winifred [Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) converses with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), sharing her frank and sharp opinions on men, local ministers, and village acquaintances like Captain Saul and [Elizabeth Russell](../character/elizabeth-russell.md). After [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) asks her to stay for tea, Miss Winifred reveals she knew Hugh was secretly listening to her comments from the adjoining room.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P39](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P57](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P71](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0071), [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS WINIFRED TOLLEY COMES TO CALL P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079)_

> Miss Winifred tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) the tragic history of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's family, including the deaths of her brother and father, and how she was coerced into marrying [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P11](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P15](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)_

> Miss Winifred recounts the tragedy of [Rufus Vane](../character/rufus-vane.md) losing his memory and intellect after a trip to [Havana](../codex/places.md#havana), leaving [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to care for him as a child for eleven years. Moved by the tragic story, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) promises to do everything she can to be a friend to [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P35](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0035), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P39](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0039), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LORNA VANE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh host their first [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) dinner at their home in [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls) with [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md), [Agatha Sowerby](../character/agatha-sowerby.md), Captain Saul, and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) in attendance. During the visit, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul exchange lively, opinionated stories and debates about local gossip, church politics, and historical feuds while Hugh entertains them. After Hugh carefully carves the geese under Nell's instructions, the group enjoys a successful feast and listens to Captain Saul's tales by the fire.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P1](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P5](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P7](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053)_

> In the kitchen, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reprimands Hugh and Captain Saul for baiting [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) before instructing Hugh to carve the geese. Hugh carves the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) meal successfully, and the group enjoys a festive dinner followed by storytelling by the hearth. Afterward, Captain Saul prepares to head back to the lighthouse and invites [Robin](../character/robin-farrow.md) to visit him.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P48](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0048), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P49](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0049), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P53](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0053), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT SEVEN GULLS P54](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0054)_

> During a cold winter at [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) spends time with [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and Captain Saul, though she senses an underlying distance and resentment from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) despite their friendship. After [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) reacts bitterly to news of Nell's upcoming child, she later gifts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) a delicately handmade baby gown. Meanwhile, Captain Saul shares his written life log with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), who wishes a talented writer like [Cedric](../character/cedric-stanhope.md) could turn his adventurous life into a book.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A SEVEN GULLS WINTER P19](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0019)_

> As spring arrives, Captain Saul and Miss Winifred visit [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh, bringing sweet-grass, quahog shells, and mayflowers. Captain Saul borders Nell's garden beds with shells, and the group engages in lively conversation and banter about theology, local gossip, and neighbors.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P6](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P10](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 18 SPRING DAYS P17](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0017)_

> [Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) comes to stay at the house to help [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) during her pregnancy and labor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a baby girl, whom she names [Joyce](../character/joyce.md), but the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh devastated. The community grieves with them as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slowly recovers while mourning her loss.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P0](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021)_

> Hugh and [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) insist that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) rest and leave the household chores to [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md). Later, Miss Winifred and Captain Saul visit, conversing about village locals and announcing that a young journalist named [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) will soon be staying with [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P2](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P11](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P19](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 22 MISS WINIFRED ARRANGES MATTERS P24](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0024)_

> [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) drops off [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) at Nell's house before rushing off to help a neighbor. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) introduces Adrian to the area, walks him over to his new lodging at the Vane house, and watches as he is struck by [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) Vane's striking beauty.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN COMES P24](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0024)_

> [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) confesses to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) his deep, secret love for [Lorna Vane](../character/lorna-vane.md), agonizing over the fact that he must leave her forever without acting on his feelings. [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) listens empathetically and agrees to write to him with news of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), until Miss Winifred arrives and breaks the somber mood with her pragmatic comments.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P2](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P9](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P18](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 26 ADRIAN TRELEAVEN’S CONFESSION P25](../source/v04-c26.md#nw-v04-c26-p0025)_

> Miss Winifred and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) chat over the newspaper obituaries and past parish stories, including a story about an overzealous evangelist named [Fiske](../character/fiske.md). [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) mourns the death of her loyal old dog [Carlo](../character/carlo.md), refusing Nell's offer of a replacement for now. After spending [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley), [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh return to [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), where Captain Saul shares news from [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) about his upcoming book publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035)_

> Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) visit Captain Saul, who agrees that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) must be informed about Rufus Vane's possible recovery. Hugh then tells [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), who decides to take Rufus to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for surgery despite her shock. Later, [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) angrily confronts [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) over the decision, though she ultimately accepts that [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) has made up her mind.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P32](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LORNA DECIDES P40](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0040)_

> [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) secures funds from Captain Saul and travels to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with Hugh and Rufus for the surgery. After returning home, Hugh and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) receive a letter from [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) with a shocking revelation: the man they believed to be Rufus for twelve years is actually his cousin, [Laurence Vane](../character/laurence.md), while the real Rufus died in Cuba long ago.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Winifred Tolley](../character/winifred-tolley.md) discuss the shocking news about Rufus Vane's death and [Laurence](../character/laurence.md) Vane's regained memory, which frees [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md). Miss Winifred recalls the similarities between the cousins and expresses relief for [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), while hinting that [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) should inform [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) of Lorna's freedom.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P18](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0018), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS WINIFRED DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P21](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0021)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing deep comfort to her and Hugh after their earlier loss. Friends and family gather to admire the newborn, whom they decide to name [James Obed](../character/james-obed.md). Afterward, [Winifred](../character/winifred-tolley.md) tells [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) that [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) plans to visit [Seven Gulls](../codex/places.md#seven-gulls), bringing up hopes for Lorna's future.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P1](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P6](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR P30](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0030)_

> Following the [Liberal](../codex/factions.md#liberal) victory in the election, [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md) visits [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to share the news and discuss politics. Later, [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) goes to the Point, where she unknowingly speaks with a newly clean-shaven [Ambrose Kerr](../character/ambrose.md). She then spends time with [Uncle Saul](../character/uncle-saul.md), who contemplates his mortality, asks her to care for his cat Matey when he dies, and listens to her recite a poem by Tennyson.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P26](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT SEVEN GULLS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

> [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and Hugh discuss recent news about old acquaintances before [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) arrives with bad news about her sister's broken leg, prompting [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) to temporarily move in. Miss Winifred approves of [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) staying with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) while [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) visits. Adrian later arrives, unsettling [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md), but [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) reassures her that Adrian has come for her and that happiness lies ahead.

> In the garden, [Adrian Treleaven](../character/adrian-treleaven.md) and [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) declare their love for one another. They join [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), Hugh, and Captain Saul inside by the hearth, where Captain Saul offers a heartfelt blessing over the couples before taking his leave. After Captain Saul and Adrian depart, [Lorna](../character/lorna-vane.md) and [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) talk warmly about Lorna's future until [Tabitha](../character/tabitha.md) returns to the house with local gossip.
